scientific_question: Are cross-day opportunities to use the same fine-scale flight corridor, within the already qualifying 50km migration cells, more recurrent in the 2013 positive stork cohort than in the 2014 non-supported cohort?

Rotics2013.source_file: Fall migrations of juvenile vs. adult white storks (data from Rotics et al. 2016)-gps.csv.zip

Flack2014.source_file: Fall migration of white storks in 2014-gps.csv.zip

observational_definition.filtering: use exact stork_2014_xytime_source_screen.audit filters: visible=false/provider outlier drop, GPS speed 5-55m/s, valid x-y, earliest qualifying source fix per bird UTC 5min bin. Never read height column.
observational_definition.candidate_set: ONLY biological bird IDs and bird-days that satisfy the fixed source's own-other-day and other-bird other-date 50km supporting cells: >=10 donor events each, >=50 scored heldout events/day, >=2 scored days/bird. Freeze to fingerprint of first source gate.
observational_definition.fine_recurrence: For each 5-minute evaluated GPS fix, binary indicator that its 5km fine subcell (inside same 50km cell) is recorded by its same bird on at least 1 DIFFERENT UTC day. Average within scored bird-day, then bird, then cohort.
observational_definition.fine_other_recurrence: The same indicator that at least one OTHER bird visited the same fine subcell on a DIFFERENT date. Compute on same target fixes, same 50km qualifying cells. Do not use same-date flock co-travel as other-day reference.
observational_definition.opportunity_contrast: per bird fine self-other-day revisit fraction minus other-bird other-date fraction; optionally positive if unique fine trajectory recurs within bird. It is a coarse proxy for repeated path opportunity, NOT measured uplift/resource availability.
observational_definition.temporal_gap: For target bird-day-coarse cell, nearest other date the focal bird has GPS in the same 50km cell. Calculate days between observations; summarize event-weighted within bird-day then equally across birds.
observational_definition.all_fix_day_fields: Compute median number of distinct 50km and 5km cells visited per bird-day; report movement-coverage differences.
observational_definition.primary_descriptive: Equal-bird mean of fine self-other-day revisit fraction, 2013 and 2014. Also report other-bird revisit and self-minus-other fractions.
observational_definition.sample_uncertainty: 5000 simple bird-level bootstrap resamples separately within each cohort for descriptive 95% percentile interval of difference (2013 mean minus 2014 mean), seed 20261021; this is exploratory, not a pre-registered causal significance test.
observational_definition.vertical_correlation: Only after source independent geometry receipt, join frozen exact per-bird altitude gain CSVs to bird IDs and calculate descriptive Spearman rho within each cohort between route fine self-minus-other and altitude ID score. No new altitude score calculation or original null rerun.
observational_definition.source_archive_dedup: Rotics 2013 and Flack 2014 archival source studies are not unambiguously environmentally independent, but animal IDs do not exactly overlap.
observational_definition.no_rescue: Do not change historical 2013 positive/2014 unsupported outcomes, do not switch to 100km, alter fine grid based on result, restrict selected birds based on geometry gain, or infer causal wind effects.

hypotheses.pattern_a: 2013 cohort may show higher fine-scale route recurrence than 2014, accounting for greater transferability of apparent altitude shapes. This is a candidate explanation; not assumed true.
hypotheses.pattern_b: If 2014 fine-route recurrence is similar or higher, route recurrence alone cannot explain non-support, focusing attention on flight conditions, age, terrain or device noise.
hypotheses.neither: Post-outcome observational between-cohort differences cannot identify a biological mechanism; low event counts or width of bird bootstrap distribution may preclude a useful discrimination.
